prompt_cn:
【场景资产图】电影级环境概念设计，用于 AI 漫剧资产库
场景：指挥中心 / wasteland
建筑：环形指挥大厅，中央下沉式主控台，环绕式大屏阵列, 工业未来主义，功能优先、无明显装饰
空间与尺度：层高约 8 米，可容纳 30 人同时作业
材料：冷轧钢板墙体、防眩光玻璃隔断、磨砂金属台面
光线：顶部线性冷白主光 + 屏幕自发光作为副光，光源方向自上而下
氛围：紧张、克制、信息密集
时代：近未来
动线：主控台为中心，人员沿环形通道单向流动
前中后景：主控台边缘与散落的纸质任务书, 操作员工位与大屏阵列, 环形走廊与安全门
多角度锁定：建筑 / 门窗 / 家具 / 地面 / 光源 / 主空间关系
允许变化：天气 / 时间 / 人物 / 灯光状态 / 道具摆放
⚠️ 背景：**不使用纯白背景**（场景与角色/道具的核心区别）
版式：单张电影级环境图，前景 / 中景 / 后景分层清晰，空间可读
品质：8K 超清、影视级场景概念设计质感
prompt_en:
Create a professional cinematic ENVIRONMENT concept design for an AI-animation / game production art library.
SCENE: command centre (wasteland)
ARCHITECTURE: circular command hall, sunken central console, wraparound screen wall, industrial futurism, function-first, no ornament
SPACE & SCALE: about 8m ceiling height, room for 30 operators
MATERIALS: cold-rolled steel walls, anti-glare glass partitions, brushed metal desks
ATMOSPHERE: tense, restrained, information-dense
ERA: near future
CIRCULATION: console at the centre, staff moving one-way along the ring corridor
FOREGROUND / MIDGROUND / BACKGROUND: console edge, scattered paper briefing sheets, operator stations and screen array, ring corridor and security doors
MULTI-ANGLE LOCK: architecture, doors and windows, furniture, floor, light sources, main spatial relationship
MAY VARY: weather, time of day, present characters, light state, prop placement
LAYOUT: Cinematic environment, circular command hall, sunken central console, wraparound screen wall, about 8m ceiling height, room for 30 operators, cold-rolled steel walls, anti-glare glass partitions, brushed metal desks, linear cool-white key light from above, screen glow as fill, top-down direction, tense, restrained, information-dense, foreground / midground / background separation, atmospheric depth, consistent architecture, physically plausible materials, cinematic lighting quality, high detail, no text, no logo, no watermark
CONSISTENCY: lock architecture, doors and windows, furniture, floor, light sources and the main spatial relationship. Weather, time of day, present characters, light state and prop placement may vary. Never restructure the space without story reason.
LIGHTING: linear cool-white key light from above, screen glow as fill, top-down direction
CINEMATIC QUALITY (concrete, not just the word 'cinematic'): controlled key light, soft fill, subtle rim light, physically plausible falloff, controlled contrast, cinematic depth, foreground / midground / background separation, restrained color palette, material separation
STYLE: cinematic environment concept art, production design quality, ultra-high detail. Quality targets: photorealistic / lifelike priority; ultra-high detail; 8K-level visual detail; cinematic lighting quality.
